title: Sample a Gaussian mean law with an acquired covariance correction
statement: For raw conservative globally L-Lipschitz g, two fresh heat-Hessian secants at the same conditional center acquire Sigma v in4 values with norm<=L^2||v||. Actual Y=gbar_n+tau Z-Jbar_k(Z)/(2tau n)+eta W,tau^2+eta^2=sigma^2, obeys TV<=L^2sqrt(d)/(2eta^2n^(3/2))+L^4sqrt(d)/(8eta^2tau^2n^2)+L^4d/(8eta^2tau^2n^2k),all n,k>=1.

requires: Original whole-vector g values; Gaussian seeds and exact-real arithmetic
Raw conservative globally Lipschitz C1,1 source; no convexity, derivative or mean oracle
Fresh sources/actions conditional on retained Z; final eta W independent and unused by queries
provides: Stratified times retain unbiasedness, law bound and cap
Second correction -Jbar^(2)(Z)/(8tau^3n^2) cancels deterministic Sigma^2/n^2 error; full law is in source
Exact mean but generally positive excess covariance; affine output Gaussian with sigma^2I+A^4/(4tau^2n^2)
assumptions: Covariance/derivative fields are analysis only; conditional action variance paid
Common rounding contracts TV; arbitrary-real finite-bit complexity unestablished
costs: Second words cost8 values; cap n+4k+8ell, no better proved general exponent
Fresh GLOBAL words: sharing centers or stratifying both at one stratum changes their target
contract.units: Every-execution original values and full marginal TV
contract.obstruction: Improves this ordinary-average sufficient order, not the best available sampler. No acquired reusable quadratic compiler, every-execution polylog query theorem, universal bit bound, priority or practical advantage.

evidence.quote: n+4k whole-vector queries on EVERY execution
evidence.range_scope: Four-value covariance action and actual positive full-law sampler with deterministic schedule.

evidence.quote: a variance comparison, not a factor-of-48 TV or runtime improvement
evidence.range_scope: Stratification preserves law/cap; separate variance and architecture obstruction.
Paid second correction; no better proved general exponent.

body: Martingale covariance identity, C_t>=eta^2I and centered-shift Taylor bound prove full law. Factor48.5731 at k=8 is only sine time-coefficient variance. Older fixed-exponent/cloud/FORS contracts remain distinct.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
